_help_hep_dir: Host folder shared with the container (the only one). Must be inside your home folder.
_help_timezone: IANA timezone for the container. Omit to use the Mac's own.
_help_container_name: Docker container name; also used by the optional hep/hep-stop terminal aliases.
_help_readonly_dirs: Folders inside hep_dir that agents may read but never change (e.g. datasets). Must exist. infrastructure/ is always read-only and is not listed here.
_help_extra_watch_excludes: Optional folder names VS Code should not watch or search (e.g. a large source checkout like g4-source). Read-only dirs are excluded automatically.
_help_remote_access: One of: none | fermilab-kerberos-host-only | ssh-key-hpc. See references/decisions.md.
_help_hpc_hosts: Only for ssh-key-hpc: hosts agents may ssh to. Each host's key must already be in ~/.ssh/known_hosts.
_help_personal: Optional, written only into your local agent policy: who you are, the email for author lines, extra working preferences.
